layers.description: Ground base: grass, dirt, sand, stone, snow, ash, water and biome-specific surfaces
Autotile edges, corners, coastlines, cliffs and biome blending
Roads, trails, bridges, stairs and dungeon passages
Flowers, cracks, puddles, debris, tracks, runes and ground detail
Trees, rocks, ore, herbs, chests, signs, doors, furniture and harvest nodes
Houses, inns, shops, temples, keeps, walls, gates and dungeon architecture
Players, NPCs, monsters, pets, mounts and boss sprites
Water animation, fire, magic, weather, portals, combat telegraphs and impact effects
Roof and canopy overlays with indoor cutaway support
Foreground foliage, arches, cave lips and depth framing

autotile.diagonalRule: diagonal corners are filled only when both adjacent cardinal edges connect

chunking.streaming: load chunks around active players; keep collision and nav data in sync with tile revisions

rules: Tile IDs are stable and never reused for unrelated art.
Each tile manifest entry records biome, layer, collision, animation and source asset.
Use nearest-neighbour scaling; do not blur pixel-art atlases.
All transition tiles must be tested against all 16 cardinal masks.
Do not use decorative overlay tiles as authoritative collision.
note: Catalog describes the existing 16x16 Game Boy tile pipeline and expands it into a consistent layered tile system. It does not claim every category already has finished artwork.
